steps.name: environment - install supabase CLI and ensure psql
steps.description: Ensure required CLI tools are present: supabase CLI and psql. If supabase CLI is missing, download the appropriate GitHub release tarball, extract to a temporary directory, detect the 'supabase' binary, move it to /usr/local/bin with correct permissions, and validate its version. Verify presence of curl, tar, gzip and install postgresql-client if psql is missing. Persist PATH via /etc/profile.d/supabase_env.sh using sudo tee with a marker to avoid duplication. All operations are idempotent and log to workspace/setup.log.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/minimalist-todo-list-226727-226766/database"
LOG="$WORKSPACE/setup.log"
sudo mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && cd "$WORKSPACE"
: > "$LOG"
# check core tools
for t in curl tar gzip; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "env-01: installing $t" | tee -a "$LOG"; sudo apt-get update -q >>"$LOG" 2>&1; sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q "$t" >>"$LOG" 2>&1; }; done
# ensure psql
if ! command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "env-01: installing postgresql-client" | tee -a "$LOG"
  sudo apt-get update -q >>"$LOG" 2>&1 && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q postgresql-client >>"$LOG" 2>&1
fi
# install supabase CLI if missing
if ! command -v supabase >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "env-01: installing supabase CLI" | tee -a "$LOG"
  ARCH_TAR="/tmp/supabase_cli_release.tar.gz"
  TMPDIR="/tmp/supabase_extract_$$"
  rm -rf "$TMPDIR" && mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
  RELEASE_URL="https://github.com/supabase/cli/releases/latest/download/supabase_$(uname -s)_$(uname -m).tar.gz"
  if ! curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 30 "$RELEASE_URL" -o "$ARCH_TAR" >>"$LOG" 2>&1; then
    echo "env-01: fallback to listing releases page" | tee -a "$LOG"
    PAGE="/tmp/supabase_releases_page_$$.html"
    curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 30 "https://github.com/supabase/cli/releases/latest" -o "$PAGE" >>"$LOG" 2>&1
    CAND=$(grep -Eo 'href="[^"]+supabase[^"]+linux[^"]+\.tar\.gz"' "$PAGE" | sed -E 's/href="([^"]+)"/\1/' | head -n1 || true)
    if [ -n "$CAND" ]; then
      if [[ "$CAND" != http* ]]; then CAND="https://github.com${CAND}"; fi
      curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 30 "$CAND" -o "$ARCH_TAR" >>"$LOG" 2>&1
    fi
  fi
  if [ ! -f "$ARCH_TAR" ]; then echo "env-01: ERROR downloading supabase archive" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; exit 2; fi
  tar -xzf "$ARCH_TAR" -C "$TMPDIR" >>"$LOG" 2>&1
  # find binary
  BINPATH=$(find "$TMPDIR" -type f -name supabase | head -n1 || true)
  if [ -z "$BINPATH" ]; then echo "env-01: supabase binary not found in archive" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR" "$ARCH_TAR"; exit 2; fi
  sudo mv "$BINPATH" /usr/local/bin/supabase >>"$LOG" 2>&1
  sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/supabase >>"$LOG" 2>&1
  rm -rf "$TMPDIR" "$ARCH_TAR"
fi
# persist PATH via /etc/profile.d safely (idempotent)
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/supabase_env.sh
MARKER="# SVC_SUPABASE_ENV_MARKER"
if ! sudo grep -Fq "$MARKER" "$PROFILE" 2>/dev/null; then
  sudo tee "$PROFILE" > /dev/null <<'EOF'
# SVC_SUPABASE_ENV_MARKER
# ensure /usr/local/bin is available in PATH without duplicating entries
case ":$PATH:" in
  *":/usr/local/bin:") ;;
  *) PATH="$PATH:/usr/local/bin" ;;
esac
export PATH
EOF
  sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"
fi
# validate tools
echo "env-01: validating installed tools" | tee -a "$LOG"
if command -v supabase >/dev/null 2>&1; then supabase --version >>"$LOG" 2>&1; else echo "env-01: supabase not available" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; exit 3; fi
if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then psql --version >>"$LOG" 2>&1; else echo "env-01: psql not available" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; exit 4; fi

steps.name: scaffolding - initialize supabase project and schema
steps.description: Create a minimal Supabase project layout if absent and ensure an idempotent schema.sql in the workspace. Run supabase init non-interactively when CLI supports it, verify expected artifacts (.supabase or supabase/config), and create a timestamped backup of any existing schema.sql before creating a new one. Also create a .env placeholder only if missing. Operates in the workspace path.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/minimalist-todo-list-226727-226766/database"
LOG="$WORKSPACE/setup.log"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# init supabase project if missing
if [ ! -d "$WORKSPACE/.supabase" ] && [ ! -d "$WORKSPACE/supabase" ]; then
  if command -v supabase >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    # try non-interactive flags where available
    if ! supabase init --project-ref minimal-todo --no-browser --skip-analytics >>"$LOG" 2>&1; then
      echo "scaffold-01: supabase init failed (see $LOG)" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2
      exit 5
    fi
    # verify artifacts
    if [ ! -d "$WORKSPACE/.supabase" ] && [ ! -d "$WORKSPACE/supabase" ]; then
      echo "scaffold-01: supabase init did not create expected artifacts" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2
      exit 6
    fi
  else
    echo "scaffold-01: supabase CLI not available; skipping init" | tee -a "$LOG"
  fi
fi
# schema management: backup existing with timestamp, create minimal schema if not present
SCHEMA="$WORKSPACE/schema.sql"
if [ -f "$SCHEMA" ]; then
  ts=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
  cp "$SCHEMA" "$SCHEMA.bak.$ts" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || true
else
  cat > "$SCHEMA" <<'SQL'
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS todos (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  title text NOT NULL,
  completed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);
SQL
fi
# create .env placeholder if missing
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/.env" ]; then
  cat > "$WORKSPACE/.env" <<'ENV'
# Local placeholder values; override via container env in real deployments
SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=anon_key_placeholder
# For direct Postgres access, set PGHOST, PGPORT, PGUSER, PGPASSWORD, PGDATABASE
ENV
fi

steps.name: dependencies - install minimal client libs and verify import
steps.description: Create a minimal package.json if missing and install @supabase/supabase-js. Prefer reproducible installs: if package-lock.json exists use npm ci; otherwise pin a lightweight version in package.json. Reinstall when package.json or package-lock.json checksum changes. Verify the module can be required by Node with a small smoke test that does not call external services. Operates in the workspace path.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/minimalist-todo-list-226727-226766/database"
LOG="$WORKSPACE/setup.log"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# ensure package.json with a pinned minimal dependency if absent
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  cat > package.json <<'JSON'
{ "name": "minimal-todo-db", "private": true, "dependencies": { "@supabase/supabase-js": "^2.0.0" } }
JSON
fi
# compute checksum to detect changes
PKGCHK="$(sha256sum package.json 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
LASTCHKFILE="$WORKSPACE/.package.json.chk"
LASTCHK="$(cat "$LASTCHKFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ "$PKGCHK" != "$LASTCHK" ] || [ ! -d node_modules ]; then
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
    npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "dependencies-01: npm ci failed (see $LOG)" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; exit 7; }
  else
    npm i --no-audit --no-fund >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "dependencies-01: npm i failed (see $LOG)" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; exit 7; }
  fi
  echo "$PKGCHK" > "$LASTCHKFILE"
fi
# smoke test: require the module without network calls
node -e "try{const s=require('@supabase/supabase-js'); if(!s) throw Error('import-failed'); console.log('IMPORT_OK');}catch(e){console.error('dependencies-01: ERROR importing @supabase/supabase-js',e); process.exit(8);}"

steps.name: testing - healthcheck scripts for Supabase/Postgres connectivity
steps.description: Create and run a safe healthcheck script that parses .env via a controlled parser (no sourcing), validates SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY heuristically, probes the Supabase REST endpoint with curl timeouts and retries, and tests psql connectivity using inline PGPASSWORD. Exit codes: 0=OK, 11=HTTP failed, 12=PSQL failed, 13=BOTH failed. Logs are written to workspace/setup.log with step/timestamp prefixes.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/minimalist-todo-list-226727-226766/database"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOG="$WORKSPACE/setup.log"
HEALTH_SCRIPT="$WORKSPACE/healthcheck.sh"
cat > "$HEALTH_SCRIPT" <<'BASH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
log(){ echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) testing-01: $*" | tee -a "$LOG"; }
# controlled .env parser: KEY=VALUE, strip quotes, ignore suspicious chars
if [ -f .env ]; then
  while IFS='=' read -r key val; do
    key=$(echo "$key" | sed 's/[^A-Za-z0-9_]*//g')
    [ -z "$key" ] && continue
    # strip surrounding quotes
    val=$(echo "$val" | sed -E 's/^\s*"(.*)"\s*$/\1/; s/^\s*\'(.*)\'\s*$/\1/')
    case "$val" in *\$*|*`*|*\(*|*\)*) val="";; esac
    export "$key"="$val"
  done < <(grep -E '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=' .env || true)
fi
SU_URL="${SUPABASE_URL:-}"; SU_KEY="${SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:-}"
[ -z "$SU_URL" ] && log "WARN: SUPABASE_URL not set"
[ -z "$SU_KEY" ] && log "WARN: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY not set"
HTTP_OK=1; PSQL_OK=1
# HTTP probe with timeout and small retries
if [ -n "$SU_URL" ]; then
  for i in 1 2 3; do
    if curl -fsS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 "$SU_URL/rest/v1" -H "apikey: $SU_KEY" -o /dev/null 2>/dev/null; then HTTP_OK=0; log "HTTP OK"; break; fi
    sleep 1
  done
  if [ $HTTP_OK -ne 0 ]; then
    # try root
    if curl -fsS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 "$SU_URL" -o /dev/null 2>/dev/null; then HTTP_OK=0; log "HTTP OK (root)"; fi
  fi
fi
# psql probe
if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PGHOST="${PGHOST:-localhost}" PGPORT="${PGPORT:-5432}" PGUSER="${PGUSER:-postgres}" PGPASS="${PGPASSWORD:-}" PGDB="${PGDATABASE:-postgres}"
  PSQL_CONN="postgresql://$PGUSER@$PGHOST:$PGPORT/$PGDB"
  if PGPASSWORD="$PGPASS" psql "$PSQL_CONN" -tA -c '\conninfo' >/dev/null 2>&1; then PSQL_OK=0; log "PSQL OK"; else log "PSQL UNREACHABLE ($PSQL_CONN)"; fi
fi
if [ $HTTP_OK -ne 0 ] && [ $PSQL_OK -ne 0 ]; then log "ERROR: both HTTP and PSQL checks failed"; exit 13; fi
if [ $HTTP_OK -ne 0 ]; then exit 11; fi
if [ $PSQL_OK -ne 0 ]; then exit 12; fi
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/minimalist-todo-list-226727-226766/database"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOG="$WORKSPACE/setup.log"
# controlled env loader (same as testing)
if [ -f .env ]; then
  while IFS='=' read -r key val; do
    key=$(echo "$key" | sed 's/[^A-Za-z0-9_]*//g')
    [ -z "$key" ] && continue
    val=$(echo "$val" | sed -E 's/^\s*"(.*)"\s*$/\1/; s/^\s*\'(.*)\'\s*$/\1/')
    case "$val" in *\$*|*`*|*\(*|*\)*) val="";; esac
    export "$key"="$val"
  done < <(grep -E '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=' .env || true)
fi
# apply schema if psql present
if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PGHOST="${PGHOST:-localhost}" PGPORT="${PGPORT:-5432}" PGUSER="${PGUSER:-postgres}" PGPASS="${PGPASSWORD:-}" PGDB="${PGDATABASE:-postgres}"
  PSQL_CONN="postgresql://$PGUSER@$PGHOST:$PGPORT/$PGDB"
  if [ -f schema.sql ]; then
    if ! PGPASSWORD="$PGPASS" psql "$PSQL_CONN" -f schema.sql >>"$LOG" 2>&1; then echo "validation-01: ERROR applying schema (see $LOG)" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; exit 8; fi
    # verify table exists using normalized output
    EXISTS=$(PGPASSWORD="$PGPASS" psql "$PSQL_CONN" -tA -c "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='todos');" 2>>"$LOG" | tr -d '\r\n' || true)
    case "$EXISTS" in
      t|true|1) ;;
      *) echo "validation-01: ERROR: todos table not found (exists=$EXISTS)" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; exit 9; ;;
    esac
  else
    echo "validation-01: schema.sql not found; skipping apply" | tee -a "$LOG"
  fi
else
  echo "validation-01: psql not available; skipping schema apply" | tee -a "$LOG"
fi
# run healthcheck
./healthcheck.sh 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG" || { echo "validation-01: healthcheck failed" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; exit 10; }
# optional supabase start (gated)
SKIP_SUPABASE_START="${SKIP_SUPABASE_START:-true}"
if [ "$SKIP_SUPABASE_START" = "false" ]; then
  if command -v supabase >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "validation-01: attempting supabase start (this requires Docker access)" | tee -a "$LOG"
      if ! supabase start --project-ref minimal-todo --non-interactive >>"$LOG" 2>&1; then echo "validation-01: supabase start failed or is unsupported (see $LOG)" | tee -a "$LOG"; fi
      supabase stop --project-ref minimal-todo >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || true
    else
      echo "validation-01: docker not available; skipping supabase start" | tee -a "$LOG"
    fi
  else
    echo "validation-01: supabase CLI not available; cannot start services" | tee -a "$LOG"
  fi
else
  echo "validation-01: skipping supabase start (default)" | tee -a "$LOG"
fi
echo "validation-01: completed" | tee -a "$LOG"
